verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own docs say it aims to be Sentry API compatible, and its GitLab and Grafana integrations read error data through that API. This implies a programmatic issue/event API exists, but GlitchTip publishes no REST API reference of its own, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. The MCP server can browse, inspect and resolve issues, but MCP is a different interface and earns no credit here. missing for 10: first-party REST API documentation, evidence of scoped/permissioned API tokens, explicit list/query/update issue endpoints, raw event fetch endpoint, OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration.
